title: [Tool] Built a free AI lore generator for indie game devs — factions, quests, dialogues in 10 seconds
author: Trick-Oven617
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev,



Solo dev here. World-building was always my bottleneck — not the code, but writing coherent lore, factions, NPC backstories...



So I built GameLore AI. You give it your universe name, genre and tone, and it generates:

— Factions with philosophy, history and dark secrets

— Characters with backstory, motivations and memorable quotes  

— 3-act quests with moral dilemmas and multiple endings

— In-game dialogues with stage directions

— Locations, artifacts, legends, prophecies



Free to try (5 generations): [gameloreai.vercel.app](http://gameloreai.vercel.app)



Would love feedback from this community — what's missing for your workflow?

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: Says free in the title but then says it's freemium. That's not how free works my guy.

replies.author: Trick-Oven617
replies.body: Merci pour le retour Cubey42, le titre était mal formulé — il y a un tier gratuit avec des limites, et des options payantes pour faire tournée le site. Je voulais surtout avoir des retours de devs qui ont ce problème de lore à gérer. Si ce n'est pas le bon endroit pour en discuter, je comprends et je retire.
